Market today: Global markets are shaky, with governments trying to calm things down, which often signals deeper issues. Midterm election uncertainty adds to the jitters. This environment is tough for your concentrated tech/chip book, especially with leveraged positions.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down 58.06% and a SELL. SPAL, a new leveraged position, is also down significantly at 31.73%. Both are leveraged, meaning drawdowns are amplified, especially on margin. SMH and QQQI are also on TRIM status.

Watch: Keep an eye on your CRWD position, which is holding up well. Also, watch for potential plays in NVDA and AAPL, as both have relevant headlines and scanner setups.

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk in your leveraged, underperforming positions while staying alert for high-conviction opportunities in strong tech names.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting SOXL given the -58.06% loss, SELL status, and leveraged decay. Re-evaluate your risk here.
SPAL: Review your SPAL position, down 31.73% and leveraged. Respect the stop at 21.38 to prevent further deep losses.
NVDA: If looking to add, NVDA has a positive headline and scanner WATCH setup: entry 227.46-227.23, stop 226.54.
